title: Excel for Absolute Beginners
subtitle: From your first cell to a summary you can show someone.
author: M2E2 Labs

cover.note: One idea per page. No jargon left unexplained.

lines: Set in Space Grotesk, Inter and JetBrains Mono.
Microsoft and Excel are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation. This is an independent guide, not published by or affiliated with Microsoft.

parts.name: Meet Excel
parts.why: What Excel is for, how its screen is laid out, and how to get around a sheet without the mouse.
blocks: A Tour of the Excel Window
Practice: First Look at the Corner Shop Sales

parts.name: Typing and moving around
parts.why: How Excel takes what you type, how it tells numbers, text and dates apart, and how to select, edit and undo.
blocks: Practice: Typing and Fixing a Short List

parts.name: Making it look right
parts.why: How to make a sheet easy to read: bold and fonts, money and percent formats, column widths, borders and colour.
blocks: Practice: Making the Sales Sheet Readable

parts.name: Your first formulas
parts.why: How to type a formula, the symbols and the order Excel uses, and the ready-made formulas that add, average, count and round.
blocks: Your First Formula: Adding Two Cells
Brackets and the Order of Calculation
AVERAGE: The Middle of a Group
MIN and MAX: Smallest and Largest
Practice: First Formulas on the Sales Sheet

parts.name: Cell references
parts.why: How a formula's cell addresses behave when you copy it: moving, locked, half-locked, and pointing to another sheet.
blocks: Locking a Cell With the Dollar Sign
Mixed References: Lock Only the Column or the Row
Practice: Copying a Formula Down the Sales Sheet

parts.name: Decisions and lookups
parts.why: How to make a cell decide: comparisons, IF, AND and OR, counting and adding what matches, looking a value up, and handling errors.
blocks: IF: Making a Decision in a Cell
AND and OR: More Than One Test
SUMIF: Adding Up Only What Matches
XLOOKUP: Finding a Value in a List
Practice: Decisions and a Lookup on the Sales Sheet

parts.name: Dates and text
parts.why: How Excel treats dates as numbers, how to pull a date apart, and how to join and tidy text.
blocks: Practice: Dates and Text on the Staff Sheet

parts.name: Organising rows
parts.why: Finding the rows you need without scrolling through all of them.
blocks: Sorting by More Than One Column
Turning Your Data Into a Table
Practice: Sorting and Filtering the Sales Sheet

parts.name: Charts
parts.why: How to choose a chart, label it, and draw the three you'll use most: column, line and pie.
blocks: Pie Charts: Parts of a Whole

parts.name: Summaries
parts.why: Totals for each group without writing a formula for every one.
blocks: Sum, Count or Average in a Summary Table
Rows and Columns: A Two-Way Summary
Practice: A Summary of the Sales Sheet

parts.name: Printing and sharing
parts.why: Getting a sheet onto paper, or into someone else's hands, the way you meant it to look.
blocks: Saving, and Which File Type to Use
Fitting the Sheet on the Page
Repeating Headings on Every Printed Page
Saving as a PDF to Share

parts.name: Checking your work
parts.why: How to read an error, see the formulas behind a sheet, and prove a total two ways.
blocks: Showing the Formulas Behind the Numbers
